summary: Restoration is prominent: develop over 750,000 ha of enclosures; afforest 36,000 ha, 7,880 ha and 771,220 ha, restore 125,011 ha, address 2.4 million ha of degraded land, rehabilitate 83,974 ha, plant 20,143,186 seedlings, and restore over 6,400 ha with around one million date palms by 2030. Mixed actions add 35,000 ha of agroforestry, 86,000 ha of silvopasture and improved management/agroforestry on 1,251,220 ha; mitigation contributions are 3.61 kt CO2e/year from assisted forest regeneration and 0.95 kt CO2e/year from reforestation. Conservation targets over 1.5 million ha of terrestrial and marine protected areas, 646,209 ha of enclosures and 480,000 ha for forest conservation. Agriculture includes 170,000 ha of irrigation, conservation agriculture on 5% of cultivable land, sustainable land management on 15% of land and 50 dairy farms. Reported degraded land is ≈19.7% of the country, the 36,000-ha afforestation target ≈9.6% of mapped forest, and irrigation ≈7.2% of mapped agriculture.
